breaking_news.headline: NPR's new chief content officer: 'I've been training for this job my whole life'
breaking_news.summary: Less than two weeks after overhauling its newsroom, NPR has hired Nadine Zylstra to be its chief content officer. She has been a top executive at Sesame Workshop, YouTube and Pinterest.

breaking_news.headline: With just days left, the U.S. opening match at the World Cup is still not sold out
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds of tickets are still available for the U.S. and Canada opening matches for the World Cup on Friday. Even more are available in resale platforms — many at below face value.

breaking_news.headline: Hey, Siri: Apple just announced a long-awaited AI update
breaking_news.summary: At its annual developers' conference, Apple put the spotlight on new AI features, while highlighting security and child safety — and critiquing the company's AI competitors.

breaking_news.headline: Social Security funds could run short by 2032, program's Trustees warn
breaking_news.summary: A trust fund that helps to finance Social Security benefits is expected to run out of money in less than seven years — unless Congress acts to patch the system before that.

breaking_news.headline: House approves bill to speed up union contract negotiations
breaking_news.summary: The House has approved a bill to slash the time it takes for newly unionized workers to get a first contract. The measure allows for government intervention if a deal is not reached within 90 days.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation tops 4% for the first time in 3 years on spike in gasoline prices
breaking_news.summary: Inflation has surged to its highest level in more than three years since the U.S. and Israel launched their war on Iran, triggering a surge in gasoline prices.

breaking_news.headline: FBI seizing evidence at California plant where chemical tank overheated
breaking_news.summary: Federal authorities served a search warrant on Wednesday at a Southern California aerospace facility where a chemical tank overheated last month, forcing 50,000 residents to evacuate because authorities feared an explosion.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX is poised for blastoff with an IPO likely to break records
breaking_news.summary: Elon Musk's rocket company, recently merged with xAI, is aiming to raise $75 billion in its initial public stock offering. It's the first of a trio of mega-IPOs from AI companies expected this year.

breaking_news.headline: Pope Leo visits Canary Islands to highlight perilous journeys of migrants
breaking_news.summary: During his trip, the Pope will appeal for a humane approach and respectful welcome for migrants seeking a better life.

breaking_news.headline: Artan to referee Uefa Super Cup after losing World Cup spot
breaking_news.summary: Somali referee Omar Artan is appointed to take charge of the Uefa Super Cup match between Paris St-Germain and Aston Villa later this summer after being denied a spot at the World Cup.

breaking_news.headline: Vance says Israeli PM Netanyahu 'has got some things wrong'
breaking_news.summary: The US vice-president says the Israeli leader "aggressively asserts" his country's interests, but they do not always align with those of the US.

breaking_news.headline: Nigeria evacuates citizens from South Africa as anti-migrant sentiment rises
breaking_news.summary: Nigeria is the latest African state to repatriate citizens following reports of xenophobic attacks.

breaking_news.headline: US and Iran exchange strikes across Middle East for second day in a row
breaking_news.summary: Iran says it responded to US strikes by targeting American assets in Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain, which reported damage to its capital city overnight.

breaking_news.headline: Deadly Sudan drone strike targets funeral procession
breaking_news.summary: Rights groups accuse the RSF paramilitary group of killing civilians in el-Obeid, a city on the civil war's front line.

breaking_news.headline: El Niño under way and threatens weather extremes, scientists say
breaking_news.summary: An El Niño event has officially started, say US scientists, raising fears of extreme weather and higher temperatures.

breaking_news.headline: Social media on trial: Four important cases to watch
breaking_news.summary: Social media firms face thousands of lawsuits, the BBC looks at four which could be significant.

breaking_news.headline: Trump says 'I love the inflation' as US prices rise at fastest rate in three years
breaking_news.summary: The US president later said he had meant that he actually loved that inflation was not higher.

breaking_news.headline: New candy stores are popping up across NYC. Why?
breaking_news.summary: While US consumer confidence is at an historic low the Big Apple's sweet shops are expanding.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX IPO: Preparing for the biggest liftoff yet?
breaking_news.summary: It’s not just about rockets: what SpaceX does and why its IPO matters

breaking_news.headline: I'd have vetoed foreign sale of UK tech giant, says Business Secretary
breaking_news.summary: Peter Kyle's comments come as the government sets out how it would back British technology companies.
